statement: H-B2 is a new seed set written after v2 was frozen. The original sealed set remains unopened (key unavailable). The old 26 seeds are not measured.
rule: configuration only if every blocker could be removed with what .eccode/behavior.json can supply (setup data, roles, environment); capability if any blocker needs a change to the frozen engine. Post-hoc judgment, not re-tested.

misses.note: a miss may carry several blocker codes

blockerCodes.C1: a required UUID4 input the example generator cannot make (Mealie declares 347 string fields as format uuid4; the generator recognises uuid, date-time, date, email): every probe is rejected with 422 before the logic
blockerCodes.C2: a multipart/binary request body (the generator builds JSON bodies only)
blockerCodes.C3: the changed file is not code (a translation JSON): the routing rule sees no public surface and the diff does not run
blockerCodes.C4: the effect is in a response header or file name, which the probe output does not record (status, body, content type)
blockerCodes.C5: the effect is visible only in a later request that depends on an earlier write; probes run independently, reads first and destructive requests last, without chaining
blockerCodes.C6: request inputs of a kind the generator never produces (padded or mixed-case strings, cross-field consistent payloads, form bodies, specific numeric pairs)
blockerCodes.C7: needs a network fetch, which the runner closes by design
blockerCodes.F1: setup data the configuration did not create
blockerCodes.F2: a role or permission combination not configured
blockerCodes.F3: the environment (database engine) of the probe run

setSpent: The implementer read every seed description to classify; the H-B2 set is no longer blind and cannot serve as a blind set for a later detector version.
